lines.trans: I am looking for info on Elise Formain.
I have a bad feeling.
You found her nice.
She asked for Bellucci and Dujardin's numbers.
No, it is not possible.
She is perhaps worse than Mathias.
She is going to eat us like sashimi.
We do not have enough evidence.
We must go through her phone.
That is what I do.
How are we going to access her phone?
You are so innocent sometimes.

meanings.en: aller chercher = to go and get, fetch

meanings.note: short for information; des infos = info

examples.text: Tu as des infos sur lui?
examples.trans: Do you have info on him?

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
usually before the noun: une mauvaise nouvelle
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

meanings.en: trouve quelque chose = think of something

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: tag at the end of a question
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: invariable in plural: un pas, des pas
c'est pas possible! = I can't believe it!

examples.trans: Maybe it's all in my head.

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Tu m'as dévorée comme une hyène!
examples.trans: You devoured me like a hyena!

meanings.note: everyday speech, with a he/she verb form
j'en ai assez = I've had enough, I'm fed up

examples.text: Il doit faire preuve de respect.

meanings.en: faire preuve de = to show, to demonstrate (a quality)

falloir.governs: il faut + infinitive, or il faut que + subjunctive

meanings.note: only with the impersonal 'il': il faut
il me faut un stylo = I need a pen
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle
comment ça va? = how are you?
accéder à = to access, gain access to
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les

meanings.note: c'est tellement stupide = it's so stupid

examples.text: J'ai été bien trop naïve ce soir.
examples.trans: I was much too naive tonight.

examples.text: Ne soyez pas si naïf avec eux.
examples.trans: Do not be so naive with them.
